title: [SmartSwitch] Orchagent might crash during boot because of invalid zmq address
author: vivekkarri
body:
<!--
     If you are reporting a new issue, make sure that we do not have any duplicates

     to the existing issue instead.

     - SONiC Support Forums - https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/sonicproject

     ---------------------------------------------------
     BUG REPORT INFORMATION
     ---------------------------------------------------
     Use the commands below to provide key information from your environment:
     You do NOT have to include this information if this is a FEATURE REQUEST
-->

#### Description

When the IP for eth0-midplane is not available for some reason, the current logic is to fallback to the ip address of the eth0

```
if [[ x"${LOCALHOST_SUBTYPE}" == x"SmartSwitch" ]]; then
    midplane_mgmt_ip=$( ip -json -4 addr show eth0-midplane | jq -r ".[0].addr_info[0].local" )
    mgmt_ip=$( ip -json -4 addr show eth0 | jq -r ".[0].addr_info[0].local" )
    if [[ $midplane_ip != "" ]]; then
        # Enable ZMQ with eth0-midplane address
        ORCHAGENT_ARGS+=" -q tcp://${midplane_mgmt_ip}:8100"
    elif [[ $mgmt_ip != "" ]]; then
        # If eth0-midplane interface does not exist, enable ZMQ with eth0 address
        ORCHAGENT_ARGS+=" -q tcp://${mgmt_ip}:8100"
    else
        ORCHAGENT_ARGS+=" -q tcp://127.0.0.1:8100"
    fi
fi
```

But there is a problem, eth0 will not have ip and it'll return null as the output for` $( ip -json -4 addr show eth0 | jq -r ".[0].addr_info[0].local" )`

and thus orchagent crashes

```
May 22 04:58:07.639331 sonic NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- main: Instantiate ZMQ server : tcp://null:8100
May 22 04:58:07.648958 sonic NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- mqPollThread: mqPollThread begin
May 22 04:58:07.649360 sonic WARNING swss#orchagent: :- main: sync mode is depreacated, use -z param
May 22 04:58:07.649360 sonic NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- set: unlocking api mutex for communication mode
May 22 04:58:07.649420 sonic NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- ~RedisChannel: join ntf thread begin
May 22 04:58:07.649460 sonic NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- ~RedisChannel: join ntf thread end
May 22 04:58:07.649602 sonic NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- setRedisExtensionAttribute: enabling redis sync mode
May 22 04:58:07.650091 sonic ERR swss#orchagent: :- mqPollThread: zmq_bind failed on endpoint: tcp://null:8100, zmqerrno: 19
May 22 04:58:07.651191 sonic INFO swss#supervisord: orchagent terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
May 22 04:58:07.651191 sonic INFO swss#supervisord: orchagent   what():  :- mqPollThread: zmq_bind failed on endpoint: tcp://null:8100, zmqerrno: 19
```
